from flask import request
import sqlite3
def lookup():
    db = sqlite3.connect("fixture.db")
    cur = db.cursor()
    value = request.form.get("name")
    alias = value
    query = f"SELECT id FROM items WHERE name = '{alias}'"
    cur.execute(query)

from flask import request
import sqlite3
def lookup():
    db = sqlite3.connect("fixture.db")
    cur = db.cursor()
    value = request.args["sort"]
    if value == "name":
        query = "SELECT id FROM items ORDER BY name"
    else:
        query = "SELECT id FROM items ORDER BY id"
    cur.execute(query)
